Name: LOT_RESULT_PLAYAREA_PARAM_ST
Description: Play areas and bosses of each map pattern, from the offline pattern lottery: the day 1 and day 2 play areas, the night bosses, extra bosses and their modifiers.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 2 rows.

Fields.Name: Pattern ID
Fields.Description: Map pattern this row belongs to (one row per pattern).

Fields.Name: Night 1 Play Area ID
Fields.Description: PlayAreaCreateParam row of the first night's play area (the shrinking circle). The pattern is not used if the row does not exist.

Fields.Name: Night 2 Play Area ID
Fields.Description: PlayAreaCreateParam row of the second night's play area. The pattern is not used if the row does not exist.

Fields.Name: Night 1 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Night 1 boss: character number (4929 = c4929). 0 or less: none.

Fields.Name: Night 2 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Night 2 boss: character number (4860 = c4860). 0 or less: none.

Fields.Name: Extra Night 1 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Second boss on night 1 (character number). It uses the attach point that the night 1 play area's PlayAreaCreateParam row gives for it. -1: none. Retail: set on 9 of 520 patterns.

Fields.Name: Extra Night 2 Boss ID
Fields.Description: Second boss on night 2 (character number). It uses the attach point that the night 2 play area's PlayAreaCreateParam row gives for it. -1: none. Retail: set on 12 of 520 patterns.

Fields.Name: Night 1 Boss Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier of the night 1 boss (e.g. 444, 439); added to the pattern's active modifiers. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Night 2 Boss Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier of the night 2 boss (e.g. 400, 402); added to the pattern's active modifiers. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Extra Night 1 Boss Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier of the extra night 1 boss; added to the pattern's active modifiers. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Extra Night 2 Boss Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier of the extra night 2 boss; added to the pattern's active modifiers. 0: none.
